clusters.pick_reason: Both PRs add near-identical quote-aware/escape-aware comma-splitting tokenizers, but #3041 goes further with _extract_bearer_auth_params, which first locates the specific 'Bearer' challenge segment before extracting its auth-params. #3012's _iter_www_auth_params instead splits everything after the first space in the whole header, so if the header contains multiple challenges (e.g. 'DPoP realm=x, Bearer error=y'), it would still lump params from unrelated schemes together -- the exact class of substring/cross-boundary bug both PRs are meant to fix. #3041's scheme-scoped extraction more completely addresses the problem.
